notes: EcoreX v0.1.12 ships the signed Windows desktop installer, a combined Windows/macOS one-click local WebUI package that opens the EcoreX browser interface after install, the web deployment package, and refreshed Admin API compatibility. macOS desktop DMG publication is deferred until Mac signing/notarization validation.

artifacts.source: Signed locally with Authenticode certificate 0F678477DFC0A2BDAAB88307126EF657FAF8674F and DigiCert timestamp.
Contains both Windows x64 and macOS arm64/x64 local WebUI installers; users run the .cmd on Windows or the .command on macOS, and the installer opens /app/ in the default browser.
Contains embedded Windows Python runtime and Install EcoreX WebUI.cmd; copies to local app data, starts the WebUI, and opens /app/ in the default browser.
Contains macOS arm64/x64 Python standalone archives, offline wheels, and Install EcoreX WebUI.command; installs locally, starts the WebUI, and opens /app/ in the default browser.

artifacts.source: Web deployment package generated by scripts/prepare-ecorex-web-release.ps1; install script defaults to VERSION=0.1.12 and opens the EcoreX WebUI after service startup when a graphical session is present.
